header:
the Mega Stones and the Megas they lead to, one section per batch of the content expansion. Each section checks its batch's
stones as one set: the stone is a marked item (handler NONE), it takes its base forme to its Mega (dfi_mega_of, the support of
the pair in the manifest), and, where the batch says so, the Mega and base abilities are marked and legal, the setup with the
stone is accepted and evolves once into that forme, and the public API reports the pair as supported. The behaviour of the
Megas is in the recorded battles of each batch (conformance_pool_data) and in the abilities' own tests.

The sections, from the tests of their steps (restructure step 6e; tests/renames.tsv maps the old names): Mega batch 2
(Swampertite, Metagrossite, Froslassite, Lucarionite Z), Mega batch 3 (G43: ten stones with no new rule), Mega batch 4 (G51:
ten stones with no new rule, and Keen Eye and Big Pecks marked for Pidgeot), the Magic Bounce stones (G57: Absolite, Sablenite,
Clefablite; Starminite unmarked), the six new Mega abilities and their stones (G59), and the simple Mega abilities' stones (G63).
